name_ja: 未来につなげる終身保険v2
name_en: Mirai ni Tsunageru Whole Life v2 (Future-Connecting Whole Life v2)
policy_name_ja: 通貨選択型一時払終身保険
notes: Rates are script-loaded from the site's JSON feed (POST /bin/rates/data) and manulife.co.jp answers HTTP 403 to non-browser clients, so the rate pages were read in the built-in browser on 2026-11-17 and saved as condensed text snapshots (format mnl-condensed-v1, see the header of each file under sources/mnl/rates/). scripts/mnl.py parses those snapshots; it cannot fetch live. New data needs a new browser snapshot.

The brief expected date-stamped rate PDFs under /documents/rates/riritsu/. Those PDFs (riritsu-N-YYYYMMDD.pdf, linked from 主な諸利率) are the insurer's generic rate list for other products, not this product's grid, so none were used or saved. The Wayback Machine was offline on 2026-11-17 (Internet Archive 'Temporarily Offline'), so no Wayback history was collected; this is a gap to retry.
has_mva is true: the product page says the surrender value is market-value adjusted (市場価格調整; a 市場価格調整用利率 page exists, not collected) and can fall below the single premium.

積立利率 is set twice a month (contract dates 1st-15th and 16th-end) and applies for the whole life of the contract from the contract date, so guarantee_terms_years is null. 告知なしタイプ also has a 第1保険期間 (2, 3, 5, 7, 10 years; the 受取コース offers 2, 5, 10) during which the death benefit grows; it is stored as term_years. 告知ありタイプ has no first-period dimension, so term_years is blank there.
age_band is the 契約年齢 band as printed: 0-34 (34歳以下), 35-39 ... 80-84, and open-ended 85+ (85歳以上) or 50+ (告知あり 50歳以上). Sex is not a rate dimension. Currency: the contract currency (円/米ドル/豪ドル).

effective_date is the first day of the half-month contract-date window; the window ends on the 15th or the month end. A '-' on the page is stored as status not_offered; the page says that for 告知なし a '-' means that currency, age and first period cannot be applied for.

History: the page's 過去の積立利率 lists only the twelve half-month windows from 2026-05-16, so the series starts there; nothing earlier is published on the page. The current window (2026-11-16 to 2026-11-30) comes from the 最新 page. Re-run with new snapshots to extend.
Rates are stated before tax (税引前). In the 告知なし tables the feed shows the same value across the offered first periods; the snapshot condenses that and the collector expands it.

Two rate pages exist: miraisyushinv2 (基本コースのみ, form MLJ(PPD)26100617) and miraisyushinv2-1 (基本コースなど: 基本/特定疾病保障/受取, form MLJ(PTD)24110855). Only miraisyushinv2-1 is collected; its 基本コース figures match the other page (checked for the latest 告知あり and 告知なし tables and for the past 告知あり 34歳以下 table). 特定疾病保障コース shares the 基本コース rates (page heading 基本コース／特定疾病保障コース).

Distributors: 17 financial institutions in four groups (the お取扱いのご案内 page); groups differ in which courses are offered (pages miraisyushin02c/02d/02e) but the page does not say which group has which set. マニュライフ生命 staff and insurance agencies also sell it (group 1 only lists them explicitly). Bank-specific product names not collected.

Plan names shortened 2026-11-17: 'Underwritten' = 告知ありタイプ, 'No health questions' = 告知なしタイプ (初期抑制型死亡のみ保障特則); the receipt course (受取コース) adds the 積立金区分特約. In the 告知なし plans term_years is the 第1保険期間 (2/3/5/7/10 years basic, 2/5/10 receipt).

Documents (2026-11-17): manulife.co.jp answered HTTP 403 to the one plain request for the brochure PDF (金融機関代理店 edition, miraisyushin02-maeshomen-fi.pdf); not worked around. The Wayback Machine holds two captures of that URL: 2024-11-07 (complete, %EOF present; cover 2024年11月版, form MLJ（PTD）24060507‐292605) and 2024-12-13 (cut off at 1 MiB, not kept). The 2024-11-07 copy is saved and flagged via_wayback / wayback_copy_may_be_out_of_date in sources/mnl/docs/manifest.csv; the rate pages cite form MLJ(PTD)24110855, so a later edition probably exists. The ご契約のしおり・約款 URL was not found: the product page that links it cannot be read from this network.

Launch date: 2024-11-01, from Manulife's release on PR TIMES (manulife.co.jp answers 403 to scripts): 新商品『未来につなげる終身保険v2』「2024年11月1日（金）から販売開始いたします」. The 2014-08 date belongs to the earlier series, not to v2. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history is short: twelve half-month windows from 16 May 2026 plus the current one, as the insurer publishes nothing earlier.
The insurer's site only answers from some networks, so rates come from saved copies and need a new copy for each period.
No archived history was collected, because the archive service was offline when it was tried; this is a gap to retry.
The surrender value is market-value adjusted and can fall below the single premium; the adjustment rates are not collected.
The brochure held is an archived copy of the November 2024 edition and may be out of date; the insurer's site refuses downloads from this network, and the policy conditions could not be located.
Launched 1 November 2024 (insurer's release). Which of the distributor groups offers which courses is not stated.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:mnl-mirai-shushin-v2; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
